This glass protector is the bodyguard your iPhone never knew it needed—just don’t blame it when your butterfingers still manage to find a way to crack the case. Perfect for the ‘I’ll just hold it like this’ crowd.

title: Dough-n't Stop Believin'
tagline: For the baker who's tired of 'just adding chocolate chips.' This book is for when your cookie game needs to evolve beyond 'chopped up Hershey bars.' Perfect for the midnight snack attack after a breakup or when you need to bribe your cat to stop judging your life choices.

title: Burger Alchemy for the Lazy
tagline: For those nights when your burger patties are more 'abstract art' than 'edible disc'. This press ensures your sad ground beef won't slide off the bun like a failed marriage. Perfect for the backyard chef who's one step away from just serving a meatball sub.

title: Princess Cake Pop Royalty
tagline: Because nothing says 'I care' like a $4 plastic tiara on a sugar-coated ball of regret. Perfect for when your kid's birthday party has more divas than a Disney audition. Just don't ask what happens if you accidentally eat one—Cinderella's glass slipper was a lie, but her choking hazard is real.

title: Beach Thief Deterrent 3000
tagline: Worried about your valuables while perfecting your sandcastle empire? The AquaVault clamps onto your beach chair, offering questionable security against seasoned towel-snatchers. Perfect for those moments when leaving your phone with Brenda from accounting feels like too much trust.

title: Dad Jokes: The Worst Kind
tagline: Perfect for when your in-laws ask you to 'share a funny story' at Thanksgiving. This deck ensures you'll be met with groans and eye-rolls, but hey, at least you'll have something to talk about during the awkward silence after dessert. Includes classics like 'Why don't skeletons fight?' and 'What do you call a fake noodle?'

title: Bourdain’s Brain Dump
tagline: For the armchair traveler who’s already watched every episode of *Parts Unknown* and still wants more. This book is like having Bourdain’s voice in your head during a 3 AM binge on street food documentaries. Perfect for the person who insists their ‘home-cooked’ meal is actually a recreation of a dish they tried in Hanoi once.

title: May the Flush Be With You
tagline: For when your weekly Star Wars RPG night *really* needs to escalate. Finally settle who gets the high ground (and the last slice of pizza) with a hand of Bespin sabacc. Just try not to let your Wookiee win all the credits again; last time, he bought a *thermal detonator*.

title: Color Outside the Lines (Literally)
tagline: For when your therapist says 'journaling' isn't enough. This downloadable coloring book is perfect for that 3 AM existential crisis where you suddenly remember you have a meeting at 9 AM. Just print it out, grab some crayons, and let your inner child take over. Bonus: It doubles as a subtle way to tell your coworkers you're not okay.

title: Recipes for Ramen Rejects
tagline: So, your microwave privileges got revoked, huh? This cookbook might be the next best thing. Perfect for those evenings when you want to impress a date with something slightly more sophisticated than instant noodles (like, *really* slightly). May not save your social life, but it's a start.

title: Alexa, Play White Noise… Again?
tagline: So, your Tamagotchi collection is now a cacophony of beeps. The solution? Drown it out with Alexa. Perfect for masking the existential dread of digital pet ownership, or convincing your neighbors you're hosting a (very quiet) rave. Just don't ask it to order more batteries... you've been warned.

title: Clothespins: The Artisanal Way
tagline: Because your laundry line deserves the same aesthetic consideration as your Pinterest board. Perfect for the urban hipster who wants to air-dry their organic cotton socks in style. Hang your delicates with the finesse of a French pastry chef, or use them as a makeshift bookmark for your vintage copy of 'The Art of Fermentation'.

title: Piano for People Who Hate People
tagline: Tired of your neighbor’s karaoke sessions? Now you can return the favor with the subtlety of a jackhammer. Perfect for those who want to annoy their roommates, impress their cat, or finally understand why your ex left you. Includes lessons on how to play 'Chopsticks' like a prodigy.

title: Emergency Cuddles (and Antiseptic)
tagline: So, Mittens decided the vacuum cleaner hose was a worthy adversary again? This first-aid kit is for the accident-prone furball in your life. Because let's be honest, your cat's nine lives are rapidly dwindling thanks to their questionable decision-making skills. Contains essential medical supplies. Cuddles, unfortunately, not included.

title: Constellation Compensation Kit
tagline: So, the observatory gig didn't pan out? No problem. Slap these glowing celestial bodies to your ceiling and pretend you're still relevant. Perfect for when you need to recreate the night sky indoors to impress...your cat.

title: Jet-Setter’s Leather Identity Crisis
tagline: For the globetrotter who’s tired of their passport looking like it’s been through a washing machine. This wallet is for the person who needs to prove they’re not a spy at border control—just a very organized one. Perfect for when you’re trying to impress customs with your ‘I travel so much I need a dedicated passport holder’ energy.

title: Sock Your Way to Cool
tagline: Because your feet deserve a fashion statement too. Perfect for the sock enthusiast who also happens to be a crochet wizard. Imagine impressing your friends at the next sock-puppet-making party with your hand-crafted Converse socks. Just don't blame us if they ask for a pair.

title: Blue Lumps of Regret
tagline: Congratulations, you've found the perfect centerpiece for your 'Why Did I Buy This?' collection. This Chalcanthite specimen is like a tiny, crumbly mood ring—except it won't change color, and it's definitely not a good idea to eat it. Ideal for the amateur geologist who wants to impress their cat with their questionable life choices.

title: Rollin' with the Punches
tagline: For the urban nomad who needs to carry their entire toolkit in one hand while fending off the existential dread of modern life. This leather roll is like a Swiss Army knife for people who’ve given up on Swiss Army knives. Perfect for the person who’s ‘just stopping by’ to fix their friend’s leaky faucet but ends up rebuilding their entire kitchen.

title: Beats: For Gym or Judgment?
tagline: So, you're committed to that interpretive dance routine at your cousin's wedding. Excellent. These Beats Fit Pro earbuds promise to stay put even during your most...*expressive* movements. Just be prepared for Aunt Carol's side-eye when you start really feeling that power ballad. Noise cancellation, indeed. Block out the haters.

title: Medieval Cosplay for the Urban Archer
tagline: For when your morning commute involves dodging arrows from a rogue Robin Hood wannabe. This leather quiver is perfect for the modern archer who needs to look stylish while pretending to be in a Renaissance fair. It's like a purse, but with more potential for accidental manslaughter.

title: Apocalypse-Chic Water Silos?
tagline: Planning a massive indoor garden that requires, say, a thousand gallons of rainwater? Or perhaps you're just *really* committed to winning the next water balloon fight. Either way, these tanks are here to quietly judge your life choices while keeping you hydrated (or well-armed).

title: Heavy-Duty Drapery for the Apocalypse
tagline: When your doomsday bunker needs a touch of class, this industrial curtain rod is the perfect blend of utilitarian and 'I have standards.' Hang your blackout curtains in style, or use it to hoist your emergency tarp in the backyard after the big one hits. Just don't expect it to hold your grandmother's lace doilies.

title: Time Traveler's Pocket Change
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm secretly a pirate' like casually dropping a 1792 half-dime at the coffee shop. Perfect for when your Tinder date asks about your 'hobbies' and you pull out a coin older than their grandparents. Comes with a magnifying glass—because squinting is part of the charm.

title: Flyer I: Backyard Edition
tagline: So, the Smithsonian isn't returning your calls about 'borrowing' the original? Understandable. This Wright Brothers kite is the next best thing. Perfect for reliving history (poorly) during that awkward family reunion where everyone judges your life choices from the picnic blanket.

title: Halo View: Vaguely Watch-Like
tagline: So, you're training for that obscure competitive thumb-twiddling championship? The Halo View tracks your *exertion* (questionable) and sleep (probably needed after all that). Ditch the smartwatch pretension; embrace quantified, low-impact living. Battery life? Long enough to judge your choices.

title: Cord Chaos? Not Today
tagline: For the person who’s tired of their vacuum cleaner cord doing the tango with their TV cables. This electric cord wall cleat is like a tiny bouncer for your wires, keeping them in line and out of your way. Perfect for the minimalist who’s also a secret hoarder of gadgets.

title: Nutrition by Subscription
tagline: For the health-conscious who’ve mastered the art of eating the same sad salad five days a week, but want to pretend they’re on a culinary adventure. Perfect for those who’ve convinced themselves that $100 a week on pre-portioned kale is a ‘lifestyle choice’ and not just a way to avoid grocery shopping.

title: His & Hers: The Divorce Starter Pack
tagline: For the couple who insists on being *that* couple at the airport. Perfect for when you're trying to find each other in a crowd of strangers who all look like they're about to divorce you. Bonus: The 'His' shirt is slightly larger, so he can carry her emotional baggage too.

title: Oreo Truffle Imposters
tagline: For when your midnight snack cravings demand the sophistication of a chocolate-dipped Oreo but your inner child still insists on the structural integrity of a cookie. Perfect for that 3 AM study session where you need to convince yourself you're eating 'artisanal' while your roommate judges you silently from across the room.

title: The Wall That Judges You
tagline: For when your minimalist apartment needs a statement piece that whispers 'I have questionable taste but excellent craftsmanship.' Perfect for the person who wants their guests to ask, 'Is that a modern art piece or just a really expensive way to hide a hole in the wall?'

title: Chasing Waterfalls, Literally.
tagline: So, you're thinking about filming your goldfish's aquatic parkour routine? Or *finally* documenting your attempts to waterski behind a remote-controlled boat? This action cam is probably less embarrassing than hiring a full film crew. Waterproofing included, because, let's face it, things are going to get wet.

title: Trip Chaos Organizer
tagline: Because nothing says 'I love you' like a spreadsheet of your in-laws' itinerary. Perfect for when your partner insists on a 'spontaneous' road trip, but you secretly need to know if there’s a bathroom within a 15-minute radius. Includes a panic button for when they suggest 'winging it.'

title: Hologram Projector for People Who Still Think 2015 Was the Future
tagline: Remember when we all thought we'd have holographic phones by now? Well, this $9 gadget is here to remind you that the future is still a few decades away. Perfect for that one friend who insists on showing off their 'cutting-edge' tech at parties, only to have everyone squint at a blurry, rainbow-tinted image of a cat. It's like a Tamagotchi, but instead of a digital pet, you get a pixelated illusion of one.

title: Pretentious Nomad's Diary
tagline: For the person who wants to document their 'authentic' backpacking experience in a way that screams 'I’m not like other travelers.' Perfect for scribbling down deep thoughts while sipping overpriced coffee in a hostel, or jotting down the names of all the street food you ate before regretting it later. Leather-bound, because nothing says 'adventure' like a fancy journal that costs more than a night in a questionable motel.

title: Therapy? Nah, Just Color.
tagline: For when adulting feels like a toddler tantrum. Unleash your inner chaos coordinator with this coloring book. Perfect for those moments when you need to passive-aggressively de-stress during a boring conference call. Or, you know, while hiding in the pantry from your family. No judgement.

title: See Better (Maybe?) At Night
tagline: Avoid that dreaded vampire look. These claim to cut nighttime glare, which is perfect if you're a rideshare driver who's also a secret agent and needs to tail someone through poorly lit industrial parks at 3 AM. Or, you know, just drive home from bingo.

title: Decaf for Cocoa Lovers
tagline: For when you want the comforting illusion of indulgence without the actual calories. Perfect for your coworker who insists on 'treating themselves' to a hot drink while counting macros. Now they can sip guilt-free, pretending it’s not just flavored sugar water.

title: Hops & Hype: A Snob's Survival Guide
tagline: For the person who can't decide between a craft beer and a personality test. This guide is perfect for your friend who insists on pairing their IPA with existential dread. Now they can finally impress the barista at the local microbrewery by name-dropping obscure hops like they're discussing their therapy sessions.

title: Soap for People Who Hate Showering
tagline: For the eco-conscious hypochondriac who suspects their last bar of soap was secretly made in a factory by robots. Handcrafted with organic ingredients, because nothing says 'I care about the planet' like paying $20 for something you could make in your kitchen. Perfect for the person who insists their soap must have a backstory, like it was carved by a monk in the Himalayas.

title: Escape Your Coworker's ASMR
tagline: Need to block out Brenda's aggressive keyboard tapping and constant throat clearing during your Zoom meetings? These headphones will let you achieve blissful silence, or at least pretend to while you subtly nod along to her quarterly report. Bonus: makes you look busy, even when you're not.

title: Beer: Not Just for Drinking
tagline: For when your culinary ambitions extend beyond 'just add beer' to 'actually cook with beer.' Perfect for the home chef who wants to impress their friends with beer-braised brats at a tailgate, only to realize they forgot to buy actual brats. Includes recipes like 'Beer Can Chicken'—because why should the beer can have all the fun?

title: BrewDog: Beer For...Someone?
tagline: So, you've meticulously arranged your amiibo collection, and your artisanal sourdough starter is bubbling nicely. But something's missing. Ah, yes, a craft beer proclaiming itself "for the people." Enjoy ironically while debating the merits of decentralized autonomous organizations with your cat.

title: Coloring: For When Therapy Fails
tagline: Remember when coloring books were for kids? Now they're 'self-care.' This one's so intricate, it'll either unlock your inner peace or trigger an existential crisis. Perfect for distracting yourself from that mounting pile of unread emails...or the slow, creeping realization that you peaked in college.

title: Touchdown, Tiny Human!
tagline: Is your toddler unusually obsessed with field goal percentages? Does your cat require more challenging obstacles than the sofa? This pint-sized post set is the answer. Finally, a way to channel that pre-school rage into slightly less destructive behavior. (Helps if you yell "Touchdown!" after each successful kick.)

title: Chocolate for the Ethically Conflicted
tagline: For when you want to indulge in a creamy, milk chocolate bar but also need to explain to your vegan friend why you're not actually a monster. Perfect for midnight snacking while watching documentaries about dairy farms. Comes in a wrapper that won't judge you.

title: Wheel Chock…of Justice?
tagline: Paranoid about rogue golf carts? This hefty wheel chock lock is your answer. Finally, you can ensure your precious ride stays put, even in the face of the most determined grocery-cart-wielding bandits. Perfect for securing your prized possession at the next competitive clown car convention.

title: Rainbow Jenga for Toddler Architects
tagline: When your tiny Picasso insists on building a 'skyscraper' out of cereal boxes, this is your chance to channel their inner Frank Lloyd Wright. Watch as they meticulously stack these wooden arcs, only to knock them down in a fit of artistic rebellion. Perfect for parents who want to pretend their kid is a prodigy.

title: Dull Blades? No Problem.
tagline: So, you're scaling that fish you caught with your bare hands (allegedly). Mid-scale, your trusty knife fails. Embarrassing. Enter this pocket sharpener. Now you can maintain peak sharpness while recounting tall tales of aquatic combat. Backwoods chic, I call it.

title: Nerd's Duct Tape

title: Knot Today, Old Man
tagline: Arthritis got you down? Can't tie a decent fishing knot to save your life? Let's be honest, Brenda, you never could. This Hook-Eze gizmo lets you pretend you still have the dexterity of a teenager while reeling in that prize-winning sunfish. Works on lures, too. No excuses for going home empty-handed now.

title: Bluetooth? In *My* Cigarette Lighter?
tagline: So, your '98 Corolla's tape deck finally bit the dust, huh? And you *refuse* to upgrade the whole system? Fine. This little gadget lets you blast your true crime podcast directly from your phone, through the static-laced glory of FM radio. Because sometimes, inconvenience is a lifestyle choice.

title: Chocolate Chaos in a Pan
tagline: For when your midnight cravings demand something more than just 'chocolatey.' These brownies are like a black hole of sweetness, sucking in M&Ms and refusing to let them go. Perfect for that 3 AM study session where you need to decide if the universe is expanding or if you're just getting taller.

title: Flat-Pack Dreams
tagline: For the minimalist who's also a college student, or the eco-warrior who's also a cheapskate. This bed is like IKEA furniture, but with the added bonus of feeling like you're sleeping on a cereal box. Perfect for the tiny apartment where your bed doubles as your coffee table, and your coffee table doubles as your 'I should probably get a real bed' reminder.

title: Fancy Scribbles for Overthinkers
tagline: For those who’ve ever stared at a blank card for 20 minutes, only to settle on 'Hope you’re doing well.' This kit turns your existential dread into elegant loops and swirls. Perfect for the person who insists their grocery list should look like a royal decree.

title: Sith Lord Starter Pack

title: Cables That Won't Quit
tagline: Tired of your cables looking like they survived a dog fight? These fray-resistant nylon wonders are here to save the day. Perfect for the 'I'll just leave my charger here' crowd or the 'I use my laptop as a stress ball' type. No more duct tape solutions, just cables that actually last longer than your last relationship.

title: Oreo's Fancy Cousin
tagline: For the cookie connoisseur who insists on paying $22 for something they could buy in bulk at the grocery store. Perfect for your 'I only eat artisanal' friend who also insists on splitting the bill evenly. Comes in a fancy box, so you can feel like you're eating a museum exhibit.

title: Swiss Army Existential Dread
tagline: Lost in the woods... again? This isn't just a knife; it's a tiny toolbox of 'maybe I can fix this myself' energy. Perfect for dismantling that Ikea furniture you swore you'd assemble before the next ice age. Or, you know, whittling a tiny boat for your anxieties.

title: Karaoke? More Like Kara-OK!
tagline: For the aspiring shower tenor who needs to practice belting out power ballads *before* subjecting their cat to a live performance. Or, maybe you just need to loudly narrate your life while doing chores. Either way, this microphone is ready for… something.

title: Lukewarm Tub Time Savior
tagline: Tired of your inflatable kiddie pool resembling glacial runoff? These solar rings promise *slightly* less shivering. Perfect for those committed to backyard wading, yet perpetually shadowed by a disapproving oak tree. Results may vary, but hey, at least you're trying.

title: Chew Toy? More Like Boudoir.
tagline: Does your pampered Pomeranian need a bone but only if it's ethically sourced (from a mold, of course)? This rubber "bone" is ready for its close-up. Perfect for the dog who's over sticks but still wants something to dramatically gnaw on while contemplating their next Instagram post.

title: The Kitchen Screen Sanctuary
tagline: Tired of your phone sliding into the mashed potatoes? This is the kitchen gadget for the multitasker who insists on scrolling through memes while stirring the risotto. Perfect for those 'just one more episode' moments when your hands are full of flour and your counter is a warzone. It's not a chef's assistant, but it'll keep your screen from becoming a side dish.

title: For Dogs Who Judge Your Mattress
tagline: Let's face it, Fido deserves better than that stained futon cushion he's been eyeing. This memory foam dog bed is perfect for when you're trying to impress a dog-sitter who's clearly judging your life choices (and your pet's questionable sleeping arrangements). Because a dog's comfort is a direct reflection of your own self-worth, apparently.

title: Beard Butter for Hipster Vikings

Perfect for the guy who wants to look like he just chopped wood but actually spends his days sipping craft beer and debating the merits of different beard oils. This is the stuff that turns your face forest into a silky-smooth woodland retreat.

title: Ego Trip: The Paperback
tagline: Forget therapy. Need to document your *brilliant* thoughts for posterity (or at least until the next yard sale)? Perfect for when you're stuck in a meeting that could've been an email, and suddenly, you're the only one with a protein-packed distraction. Handcrafted, because even your snack deserves a backstory. Just don't ask why they're shaped like that.

title: Tuxedo: The Subscription

Bonus: The dry-cleaning bill is on them. Perfect for the guy who’s ‘borrowing’ his brother’s suit for the fifth time.

title: Paper That Knows Your Struggle
tagline: For those who've ever stared at a blank printer tray, wondering if life could be more like *The Office*. This premium copy paper comes with a free existential crisis—because nothing says 'I’ve made it' like spending $30 on paper that’s slightly less likely to jam. Perfect for the remote worker who needs to print their grocery list in style.

title: Apple's $100 Wireless Clinger
tagline: For those times you're committed to the *aesthetic* of wireless charging but also need to ensure your phone dies slower than a Tamagotchi. Perfect for stealthily adding weight to your iPhone when you suspect someone's about to swap it with a cheaper model. Also works as a fidget spinner, technically.

title: The Blanket You Can Wear

Ideal for when your cat decides your lap is a construction site and you need to shield yourself from the sawdust. Bonus: doubles as a fort for your coffee mug.

title: Fancy Toast Toppers
tagline: For when you've run out of creative ways to ruin your morning toast. These gourmet marshmallows are the perfect way to turn your sad, solitary piece of bread into a 'decadent' breakfast experience. Ideal for those who've given up on cooking but still want to pretend they're a culinary genius.

title: The Ruler That Judges Your Life Choices
tagline: For those moments when you're at a flea market, debating whether that 'vintage' lamp is actually just old and sad, this pocket ruler is your silent arbiter of truth. It won't tell you if your taste is questionable, but it will confirm if that 'handmade' sign is actually just crooked. A tool for the discerning bargain hunter who needs precision in a world of dubious deals.

title: Dessert Identity Crisis (Cookies And)

title: Cookies That Think They're Cake

These cookies are like a dessert identity crisis—white chocolate chips trying to pass as cake crumbs. Perfect for the office potluck where you need to bring something but forgot until 10 minutes before.

title: Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Bake...Maybe?

title: Shatterproof Paranoia

Because let's face it, your phone's more fragile than your ex's ego.

Finally, you can passive-aggressively confront Brenda armed with timestamped evidence.

title: Bookshelf Brag Rights

Perfect for that one friend who always posts about 'the good old days of literature' on Facebook.

title: Canine Car Cage Couture

title: Baby's First Anxiety Cage

title: Tire Savior Alert

This daily calendar provides 'life hacks' so questionable, you'll spend more time debating their utility than, say, filing your taxes. Perfect for fueling existential dread with marginally useful tips.

tagline: When your phone, tablet, and two random gadgets all die at once, this four-port USB wall charger becomes your unlikely hero, saving you from a night of tedious charging shifts.

title: Fill-in-the-Blank Drunk Tank
tagline: Because charades is *so* last Tuesday. Need a way to liven up that awkward family reunion where everyone pretends to like your new vegan cheese wheel? Unleash the Mad Libs. Just try not to let Uncle Jerry fill in 'body cavity' for every noun. May spontaneously combust from forced hilarity.

title: Pancake Perfection, Sans Mess
tagline: So, you're making pancakes for that picky eater who demands perfectly uniform circles, or chaos will reign? This batter dispenser ensures flawless flapjacks, and perhaps, prevents a toddler meltdown. Also works for portioning cupcake batter, if you're into that sort of obsessive baking.

title: Log Slices for Your Sweaty Glasses
tagline: For when your Ikea coffee table can't handle another ring, but you refuse to live in a world where coasters are made of anything other than reclaimed lumber. Perfect for the backyard philosopher who needs to put down their IPA and pick up a splinter.

title: Egg-cellent Headwear, Indeed.
tagline: So, you're staging an avant-garde production of nursery rhymes, and Humpty Dumpty *absolutely* refuses to emerge from his shell without proper royal attire? We get it. This crown is the only thing separating a successful performance from total yolk-induced chaos. Audience members will understand *exactly* your artistic vision.

title: Perpetual Pun-ishment Calendar
tagline: For the individual who unironically enjoys being the family's comedic black sheep. Stuck in a silent retreat and desperately need to break the tension with a well-timed (or terribly mistimed) gag about parallel lines? This calendar is your alibi. At least you can blame the bad joke on the date.

title: Currency Chaos Organizers
tagline: Returning from that vaguely-legal international scavenger hunt? Now you can meticulously sort your ill-gotten gains. Forget dumping it all in a jar; these bags whisper, "I have standards," even when dealing with slightly-melted Euros found behind a kebab stand.

title: Bourdain: Salty Wisdom On Demand
tagline: Need to sound insightful at your next painfully hip dinner party? Skip the small talk; just casually drop a Bourdain quote. This book is cheaper than therapy and far less judgmental. Pairs well with a brooding stare and a glass of something obscure.

title: Candy-Coated Compliance, Anyone?
tagline: So, your kid thinks vegetables are a biohazard? These gummy vitamins might just be the key to surviving family dinner. Imagine: You, calmly enjoying your lukewarm meal while a chorus of tiny, artificially-flavored chews fills the air. Sanity, disguised as a sugar rush. It's a win... sort of.

title: See Clearly, Drive Questionably
tagline: For the driver who insists on wearing sunglasses at dusk (you know who you are), these polarized lenses might actually help. Or, at the very least, they'll give you a fighting chance against that blinding glare from the chrome bumper of your neighbor's excessively polished hearse. Safety first, style...eventually?

title: Brain Food: Questionable Flavor
tagline: Regurgitating facts from the internet gets old. Expand your mind with this hefty tome of trivia. Perfect for those moments when you need to sound marginally more intelligent while cornered at a family gathering. Or, you know, winning that bar trivia night against Chad from accounting.

title: Backyard Fireworks, Guilt-Free!
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your annual 4th of July display? Pacify them with these solar firework lights. They're about as visually impressive as a damp sparkler, but at least you can claim you're saving the planet while gently disappointing everyone within eyesight. Perfect for passive-aggressive patriotism.

title: Root Beer: The Dark Elixir
tagline: So, your artisanal soda fountain dream stalled because you lack, uh, plumbing? This root beer variety pack is your next best bet. Perfect for when you need to convince your book club that you're *totally* over that devastating kombucha brewing incident. Each sip promises a unique flavor journey... mostly towards dental decay.

title: Keys? Wallet? Sanity?
tagline: Losing your keys in the couch cushions *again*, Bartholomew? Attach one of these trackers. Then, download the app, and let your phone lead you on a merry, beeping scavenger hunt through your own living room. Think of it as geocaching, but with slightly lower stakes (and higher chances of finding spare change).
